summary: Both halves inspected, with enlargements of the cancelled display, the extra superscript over p, the RH display and for A. The three equivalence signs are hand-drawn. The cancelled display remains unreadable as a complete formula, though p,A and raised ab fragments survive. A separate blacked superscript above p in the long LH identity is restored. The supposed stray comma after K_A-prime is actually the prime belonging to the subscript A, so the draft duplicated a single mark. The prose cancellations the,for A,bein,corres and an quasi iso are readable. Thus and singular augmentation map are clear. End punctuation of the long LH line remains clipped.
